newsitem.title: USA: U.S. April business inventories rose 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. April business inventories rose 0.3 pct.

text.p: The Commerce Department said U.S. April business inventories rose 0.3 percent after rising a revised 0.2 percent in March. It said April business sales also rose 0.3 percent after a revised 0.2 percent fall in March.
The following lists business inventories and sales by sector, in billions of dollars, seasonally adjusted:
Wall Street economists had expected April business inventories to rise 0.2 percent.
The inventory-to-sales ratio is a measure of how long it would take to sell existing stocks at the current pace.

The department said that retail inventories increased by 0.8 percent in April to $317.89 billion. It was the largest monthly increase in retailers' excessive stocks of unsold goods since a 1.3 percent increase in July last yxp?xid.
The department previously reported March business inventories had risen 0.3 percent but revised that down. It previously said March business sales were down 0.3 percent but revised that estimate.
